comparison.objective: Inspect two safety light curtains with test rods and tag the faulty machine.
comparison.physical_skill: Guide a rod across a sensing field, observe an indicator, and place a tag.
comparison.success_condition: Both fields are fully tested; only the faulty machine is tagged; rods and hands are clear.
comparison.reason: The candidate physically separates mixed loose bodies through a sieve and reseats the loaded screen; this record tests sensor inspection and fault-dependent tagging.
